title: Frame Feet Aft of Frame 55 — Corrosion Inspection and Material Loss Measurement

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Detailed visual and ultrasonic thickness inspection of the frame feet between frame 55 and the rear pressure bulkhead, with the measurement grid, the recording form and the acceptance limits for material loss.

sections.purpose: This task establishes the remaining material at each frame foot in the aft bilge and decides whether the foot is acceptable as found, acceptable after blend-out, or beyond limits and subject to an engineering assessment.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task only after the wash and dry task is complete and the surfaces are free of deposit. The ultrasonic thickness gauge must be calibrated on the reference block for the frame material before each session and again at the end. One person can do the measurement but a second is needed to record and to hold the light in the outboard positions.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the cleaning task is signed off and that the surfaces are dry. 2. Mark the measurement grid on each frame foot at 25 mm intervals along the foot, starting at the forward end. 3. Calibrate the ultrasonic thickness gauge on the reference block and record the calibration. 4. Do a detailed visual inspection of each foot under a light of at least 1 000 lux. Look for pitting, exfoliation, blistered paint and any change of colour at the foot radius. 5. Record the position and the type of every indication on the recording form. CAUTION: DO NOT REMOVE PAINT TO IMPROVE ACCESS WITHOUT AUTHORISATION. THE PAINT IS PART OF THE PROTECTIVE SCHEME. 6. Measure the material thickness at every grid point and record it. 7. At any point where the reading is below the nominal by more than the blend-out limit, take four further readings around it at 10 mm spacing. 8. Compare the minimum recorded thickness at each foot against the limits table. 9. Where the loss is inside the blend-out limit, mark the area for blend-out and re-protection. 10. Where the loss is beyond the limit, stop, do not blend, and raise an engineering query with the recorded grid. 11. Do a visual check of the lower frame cleat assembly D5331118141717 and the outboard shear tie sub-assembly D5331119974905 for any secondary damage.
sections.close_out: Photograph any indication that is beyond the blend-out limit with a scale in frame. Send the completed recording form to the operator engineering department and, where required by the applicable service bulletin, to Aeralis. Do not close the compartment until the disposition of every out-of-limit finding is agreed.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the limits table differs between the twin-engine and four-engine frame standard and both are given

safety_precautions: Use a low-voltage inspection lamp in the bilge.
Do not enter the belly fairing without the fall protection harness.
Make sure the compartment is ventilated.
